summary: Strong delivery: YAML uses pinned action refs (commit hashes) + least-privilege permissions; aggregator.py has proper type hints, dataclasses, custom exceptions, and comprehensive validation; bash harness uses set -uo pipefail, quoted vars, secure mktemp. Minor issues: render_markdown appends 30+ lines (could factor into helpers), test harness assumes fragile "Job succeeded" output pattern, some redundant assertion logic in bash (lines 40-50 repetition). Fixtures not shown; can't verify. Production-ready but refactoring render_markdown and parameterizing act output assertions would improve robustness.
